note: South African rand. The statements print millions; figures here are the full amounts. Revenue is the printed income line, made up of net gaming win, food and beverage, rooms and other revenue. Cost of sales is the printed gaming levies and Value Added Tax line, which is the direct levy on gaming income, and the printed gross profit is derived from those two printed lines. Operating expenses aggregate the printed employee costs, other operating expenses, amortisation and depreciation and impairments of non-current assets, less the printed impairment reversals of 10,000,000; the printed fair value adjustment of investment properties of 5,000,000 sits outside them, so Revenue less cost of sales less operating expenses plus that adjustment equals the printed operating profit of 2,455,000,000. Net finance costs are the printed finance costs of 603,000,000 less the printed finance income of 34,000,000. The share of profit of associates of 6,000,000 is printed and sits between net finance costs and profit before tax. Earnings per share is printed as 126 cents.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2026, FY2025: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
